checkpoint_rule: Evaluate fixed final host epoch only; no best-epoch selection
promotion: SupCon must improve final pilot accuracy by at least 0.01 over identical CE training before broader confirmation. Neither pilot alone qualifies for submission.
attribution: LoRA and supervised contrastive learning are established methods. Joint CE plus cross-prompt supervised contrastive adaptation here is our experimental combination, not a reproduction of the image-learning paper. Public pool credited to Nishant Dahal and original contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0).
limitations: One repeatedly inspected host fold, not untouched confirmation
4500-row external cap screens objectives before scaling
Small contrastive batches may limit the benefit
Host-based external near-match exclusion uses unlabeled host text only for conservative leakage screening
